approvers: Nobody else; the owner decides alone
reason: We don't buy this today and I'm not creating a new budget line and a new supplier for a coating I'd have to trust on our clients' frames. If it marks the frame or the glass when it comes off, I'm left carrying it, and at about €19 per m² it costs more than the damage it prevents on our small jobs.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and I will not take that risk on a client's windows.
instead: Keep doing what we do now: ask the glazing installer to cover the frames with cheap protection film or tape, and clean up at handover.
would_change_my_mind: ACHV or the manufacturer accepting written liability for frame and glass damage on removal, backed by insurance, plus a reference from a contractor I know in Malta.
